bullish.title: Honeywell Sees Strong Orders, Targets 15% EPS Growth in 2027

bullish.title: The Bull Case For Honeywell (HON) Could Change Following Its AI-Focused Automation And Software Pivot
bullish.reason: 分析指出 Honeywell 轉向 AI 驅動的自動化與軟體業務，可能成為未來股價重估的關鍵催化劑。

bearish.title: Honeywell Slides 5% As Future Growth Guidance At Chicago Investor Event Dissapoints

bearish.title: HON Stock Declines 51.5% in 6 Months: Should You Buy, Hold or Sell?

bearish.title: JP Morgan Maintains Overweight on Honeywell Intl, Lowers Price Target to $255
bearish.reason: 儘管維持買進評級，但摩根大通下調目標價至 255 美元，反映出對短期成長動能放緩的擔憂。

bearish.title: Jim Cramer Revealed What Went Wrong With Honeywell Aerospace Inc. (NASDAQ:HONA)
